name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 3 Advanced — Abandon the Fetters

system.description: Mixing a Blood Trait each from yourself, the bound subject, and the subject's regnant, then subjecting the bound Kindred to a night of excoriation, you can shatter an existing blood bond outright. The subject suffers four levels of aggravated damage and loses one permanent Willpower Trait, while you suffer one level of aggravated damage yourself; a successful Static Challenge completes the rite, though it offers no protection against forming a new bond later.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
